name: Kind Words
overview: Scripture reveals that kind words have a powerful and uplifting effect, strengthening those who are weak and offering health to the soul, as seen in Job's affirmation that words can uphold the falling and Proverbs' depiction of the tongue of the wise as bringing health. The psalmist's desire for his words to be acceptable to God underscores the importance of speech aligned with godly meditation. Moreover, Proverbs contrasts the destructive nature of harsh words with the peace-making power of gentle answers and timely encouragement, highlighting that pleasant and well-timed words bring joy and spiritual vitality.
